text: Management Science and Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that integrates knowledge from management, mathematics, engineering, information technology, etc. Its core lies in using scientific theories, quantitative methods, and systematic thinking to solve complex problems in management areas such as organizational operation, resource allocation, and decision optimization, ultimately achieving "efficiency improvement, cost reduction, and scientific decision-making". It focuses on "how to manage systems (such as enterprises, projects, supply chains, etc.) in the most optimal way", and is the core supporting discipline for modern management's transition from "experience-driven" to "data and model-driven".
